pages.title: The Garage
pages.tagline: Three Uruses photographed here; Cullinan, Spectre, Ferrari and more on call — text for photos and dates.
pages.intro: Daily or for the full stay, delivered to your door or waiting at the airport. Every car comes through operators we've rented from ourselves; we handle the paperwork, the delivery window and the return so you don't. Standard requirements: valid driver's license, full-coverage insurance, security deposit.

pages.title: The Water
pages.tagline: Biscayne Bay by day, the skyline by night — captained, stocked, sized to your group.
pages.intro: Four-hour charters are the standard; sunset and midnight slots book fastest. Most boats carry 13 guests under Coast Guard rules; we have 30- to 50-guest yachts for the big nights. Captain and crew included, pickup from Brickell and Miami Beach marinas, jet skis by the hour to match. We've run these boats for our own parties — July 4th link-ups, birthdays, three-yacht fireworks nights.
pages.sms_body: Hi! Saw the yachts on your site. My date + group size:

items.name: 55-ft Flybridge
items.blurb: The workhorse of Biscayne Bay — big open cockpit, flybridge for the views, a cabin to cool off in. Sunset runs past the Brickell skyline.

items.name: 45-ft Larson
items.sub: Miami · up to 13 guests · the value pick
items.blurb: Fast, clean, and the easiest yes for a first boat day. Ties up with the bigger boats for link-ups.

items.name: 75-ft Pershing & the big boats
items.blurb: For the night that needs a real yacht: 75-ft Pershing with the jacuzzi open, 80-ft Azimut, twin 90-footers for a link-up, and 100-footers for 30 to 50 guests. Booked with deposit; balance at the dock.

items.name: 100-ft Motor Yacht
items.blurb: The big one — flybridge lounge, jet skis kept at the boat, meets at 43rd Street across from the Fontainebleau.

items.name: DC · Potomac Charters
items.blurb: Home-market boats for DC weekends — express cruisers and cabin boats on the Potomac with full galleys, aft cabins and LED-lit decks for the night run under the bridges.
